test_titles: ISOLATION: PostgreSQL17, Unix socket, restricted migrator and six private tables
M14: no API role can directly read/write new tables or execute the installed gateway
M12: default gates observe; no authoritative/quiescing state can be installed
M13: future recovery/internal send purposes cannot become ready or authoritative
M15: new conversation structure stays disabled/paused; seller cannot acquire channel authority
STOCK-HOOK: even fixture-ready gates cannot activate the installed handler
M01: same command_id and same intent have one logical result
M02: same idempotency key/hash with a new command UUID replays the original
M03: a changed payload under the same key conflicts without another effect
M04: stale aggregate/assignment versions reject before applying
M05: caller actor/role cannot be supplied in envelope or payload
M06: inactive user cannot apply a command or recover an old replay
M07: foreign, unassigned and formerly owned scopes are denied without receipt disclosure
M08: effect/event/receipt/version commit atomically and SQL hash matches the actual JS contract
M09: backend crash before COMMIT leaves no partial receipt/event/effect
M10: retry after COMMIT from a fresh connection returns the committed result
M11: two real sessions race on one command; observed lock wait, exactly one application
FAILPOINT: exception after synthetic DML rolls back every command effect
GATE-VECTOR: changing one domain epoch does not borrow authority from the other
VERSION-EXHAUSTED: safe integer ceiling cannot overflow into an imprecise JS version
BUSINESS-DEDUPE: different keys cannot duplicate the synthetic operation identity
DEFERRED-GUARD: evaluating receipts cannot commit
APPEND-ONLY: terminal receipts/events/policy reject mutation and TRUNCATE
DEFERRED-EVENT: an event cannot later attach to a rejected receipt
CONCURRENT-CAS: distinct intents at one version produce one effect and one conflict
FINAL-INVARIANTS: no evaluating receipt/orphan event; new channel authority remains closed
